overall_assessment: The launch-preparation roadmap defined in conductor/launch-preparation-roadmap.json and governed by scripts/check_launch_preparation_roadmap.py, tests/test_launch_preparation_roadmap.py, and ROADMAP.md provides an exemplary, executable coordination structure for the Searchright release path. The roadmap establishes 16 dependency-ordered work packages (LP-001 through LP-016) forming a strictly verified directed acyclic graph (DAG) with zero self-dependencies, circularities, or dangling references. Crucially, single-track ownership is enforced across all 16 work packages: LP-001 (Track 10), LP-002 (Track 24), LP-003 (Track 34), LP-004 (Track 04), LP-005 (Track 02), LP-006 (Track 05), LP-007 (Track 06), LP-008 (Track 08), LP-009 (Track 32), LP-010 (Track 16), LP-011 (Track 28), LP-012 (Track 29), LP-013 (Track 33), LP-014 (Track 35), LP-015 (Track 36), and LP-016 (Track 37), preventing responsibility diffusion. Each work package specifies executable commands, required receipt paths in verification/receipts/, and concrete, fail-closed exit criteria. Furthermore, 11 work packages are explicitly designated as external gates (external_gate: true), guaranteeing that live provider access, downstream consumer cutovers, human usability, and independent methodological trials cannot be disguised as internal technical milestones. The progress model is strictly evidence-backed: LP-001 is validated as 'completed' backed by four official MCP receipts, LP-002, LP-005, and LP-006 are recorded as 'partially_evidenced' with explicitly enumerated remaining gates, and the remaining 12 work packages are held as 'not_started'. The overarching status is fail-closed to 'not_ready'.
verified_invariants: complete 16-package DAG: LP-001 through LP-016 form an acyclic graph with all dependencies resolved within the package inventory
single-track ownership: each work package is owned by exactly one Conductor track, preventing diffused authority
executable verification commands: all 16 work packages define non-empty, actionable terminal commands
explicit required receipts: all required receipt paths are named under verification/receipts/ without generic placeholders
fail-closed exit criteria: every package defines objective qualitative and quantitative criteria that must be satisfied prior to completion
external gate transparency: 11 packages requiring live, operational, or third-party evidence are explicitly flagged as external_gate: true
truthful progress accounting: progress state accurately reflects 1 completed, 3 partially evidenced, and 12 not started packages; roadmap status is 'not_ready'
automated DAG and schema validation: scripts/check_launch_preparation_roadmap.py and tests/test_launch_preparation_roadmap.py pass deterministically (10/10 tests green)

findings.description: While LP-001 is completed and LP-002, LP-005, and LP-006 are partially evidenced, 12 work packages remain not started; execution of the full dependency sequence is required prior to release candidate admission.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate 'Execute all 16 launch-preparation work packages and preserve their named receipts' until all 16 work packages reach completed status.

findings.description: Projection of work packages as native GitHub subissues (track-30-phase-3-task-01 through task-16) ensures GitHub synchronization without delegating canonical authority away from Conductor.
findings.recommendation: Maintain additive-only synchronization when updating remote task projections during execution of subsequent launch packages.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Launch preparation roadmap defines 16 executable work packages in an acyclic DAG with single-track ownership, commands, required receipts, and exit criteria; fully verified by test suite.
Roadmap cleanly coordinates maturity gap closure by mapping critical blockers to executable launch work packages without premature evidence promotion.

limitations: Source-verified launch preparation roadmap and DAG coordination model only; execution of work packages LP-002 through LP-016 and gathering of required operational receipts remain open gates.
